hook: Delete every goal he ever scored. He's still the highest scorer in history.
story: Wayne Gretzky, the Canadian they call The Great One, won four Stanley Cups with the 1980s Edmonton Oilers. Now, in hockey, a point is a goal or an assist. Gretzky retired in 1999 with 894 goals and 1,963 assists: 2,857 points. Second place in the entire history of the sport, Jaromir Jagr, has 1,921.
number: Which means: erase all 894 of Gretzky's goals, and his assists alone, the goals he set up for other people, still beat everyone's everything. He also owns the only four 200-point seasons ever played, and retired holding 61 NHL records.
closer: No one has worn his number, 99, in the league since. No one ever will.
